title: The Lucky boy with the ticket
subtitle: 成功成就 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 成功成就（做人与做事·成功与成就）
meta: 主题语境：成功成就（做人与做事·成功与成就）　|　核心词汇：lucky　|　正文 336 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 lucky 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1968 the teacher wrote of ① a lucky boy with the ticket in the notebook, and everybody in the classroom said at once that it was ② luckier than the one named there the year before. Three terms on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the teacher, who never explained anything, had done it in silence and gone home; it was the lucky ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the luckiest boy with the ticket anybody in the classroom had ever seen, or so the notebook for March 1962 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too lucky to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the pupil who had come to help; the lucky ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the ruler at the far blackboard, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a lucky escape from the fire, and said that no pupil in his right mind would call it ⑥ as lucky as the escape from the fire they had once had in the old classroom. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was lucky or not, and he said so.

By 1975 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the notebook. What the line asked for was ⑦ something lucky, and nothing besides. The pupil from the next classroom called the whole plan ⑧ quite lucky; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the notebook kept the names of the lucky ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1978, twice over, she wrote of another lucky boy with the ticket in the same notebook, and the work, which took two terms, seemed ⑨ luckier than anybody had expected. ⑩ The luckiest escape from the fire in the whole classroom, she said in 1980, was the one she could never quite name; the lucky ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 幸运（前置定语 a lucky boy with the ticket：1968 年先生在笔记簿里记下的那件幸运的儿）
B. adj. 幸运／侥幸（比较级 luckier than：文中两处，一处比拿着那张票的幸运儿，一处比预想）
C. adj. 幸运／侥幸（最高级 the luckiest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 幸运（表语 too lucky to do：母亲觉得它太幸运，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 侥幸（前置定语 a lucky escape from the fire：叔叔把整件事称作一桩侥幸的从火里侥幸脱身）
F. adj. 侥幸（同级比较 as lucky as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩从火里侥幸脱身相比）
G. adj. 侥幸（后置定语 something lucky：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 侥幸（受程度副词修饰 quite lucky：那位学童的评价）

items.q: a lucky boy with the ticket
the luckiest boy with the ticket anybody
a lucky escape from the fire
The luckiest escape from the fire in

answers.why: lucky 意为“幸运”，1968 年先生在笔记簿里记下的是“一件幸运的儿”，此处作前置定语 a lucky boy with the ticket。
lucky 意为“幸运”，此处用比较级 luckier than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
lucky 意为“幸运”，笔记簿上 三月 那行字说它是教室里最幸运的一件，故用最高级 the luckiest boy with the ticket。
lucky 意为“幸运”，母亲认为这件东西“太幸运了，谁也用不上”，too lucky to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
lucky 意为“侥幸”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩侥幸的从火里侥幸脱身”，此处作前置定语 a lucky escape from the fire。
lucky 意为“侥幸”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩从火里侥幸脱身一样侥幸”，同级比较用 as lucky as。
lucky 意为“侥幸”，笔记簿上那半行字要的是“侥幸的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something lucky。
lucky 意为“侥幸”，邻教室来的那位学童认为这套计划“相当侥幸”，quite 修饰原级 lucky。
lucky 意为“侥幸”，1978 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要侥幸”，故用比较级 luckier than。
lucky 意为“侥幸”，母亲 1980 年说的是“整个教室里最侥幸的那一桩”，故用最高级 the luckiest escape from the fire。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1968 年，先生在笔记簿里记下了一件幸运的儿。（a lucky boy with the ticket）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更幸运。（luckier than …）
母亲觉得它太幸运，谁也用不上。（too lucky to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩侥幸的从火里侥幸脱身。（a lucky escape from the fire）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩从火里侥幸脱身一样侥幸。（as lucky as …）
到了 1975 年，笔记簿上只剩半行字：要的是一件侥幸的东西。（something lucky）
answers: In 1968 the teacher wrote of a lucky boy with the ticket in the notebook.
Everybody said it was luckier than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too lucky to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a lucky escape from the fire.
He said nobody would call it as lucky as the escape from the fire they had once had.
By 1975 the notebook asked for nothing but something lucky.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 lucky 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1968 the teacher wrote of a lucky boy with the ticket in the notebook, and nobody forgot it.
It was the luckiest boy with the ticket in the classroom, or so the notebook says.
My mother thought it too lucky to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a lucky escape from the fire, and nobody argued with him.
The pupil from the next classroom called the plan quite lucky, and everybody laughed.
The lucky ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
